description: ST5 revenue increased by 2.61M (429.6%), from 607.0K to 3.21M versus the prior period, representing about 74.2% of the total increase in revenue. Most of this revenue gain came from more sales volume rather than a change in average revenue per item.

insight.title: ST5 drove most revenue growth
insight.summary: ST5 revenue reached 3.21M from 607.0K, delivering 74.2% of the total increase. That means most of the period's revenue gain came from one store. The gain was largely tied to higher sales volume, with little change in average revenue per item.

description: CONSUMER GOODS revenue increased by 2.00M (10.0%), from 20.13M to 22.14M versus the prior period, representing about 57.1% of the total increase in revenue. Consumer Goods was the biggest contributor to the revenue increase and also remains the largest part of sales.

This matters because the division is carrying the largest share of growth and a large part of current sales. The increase was supported more by extra units sold than by a change in average revenue per item.

description: ST1, ST4 recorded 24.30M in revenue, representing about 58.7% of current revenue. ST1 and ST4 together make up most of current sales, so changes in these stores will heavily shape the total result.

insight.title: Sales base sits in ST1 and ST4
insight.summary: ST1 and ST4 together generated 24.30M, equal to 58.7% of current revenue. That gives these two stores outsized weight in the total business result. Any change in either store will have a strong effect on overall sales.
insight.action: Compare ST1 and ST4 departments to confirm which areas hold most of the current sales base.

label: ST1, ST4

description: ST4 revenue increased by 1.19M (10.6%), from 11.24M to 12.42M versus the prior period, representing about 33.8% of the total increase in revenue. The increase was driven much more by average revenue per item than by extra units sold.

insight.title: ST4 growth came from value
insight.summary: ST4 revenue increased to 12.42M from 11.24M, contributing 33.8% of the total increase. That is a strong lift for one store and it adds a large share of the overall gain. The change came far more from higher average revenue per item than from extra units sold.
insight.action: Examine ST4 departments and products where average revenue per item increased most.
